g.card: Shintsha izishintshi zojantshi bese uqondisa yonke inqola yemayini emnyango wokuphuma wombala wayo.
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: amaphazili ojantshi angu-90 emihumeni yekristalu engu-6. Shintsha izishintshi bese uqondisa yonke inqola emnyango wombala wayo.
g.p1: Izinqola ziphuma emhubheni bese zigingqika zodwa. Shintsha izishintshi ukuze ngayinye ifike emnyango wombala wayo ngaphandle kokushayisana.
g.p2: Amazinga angu-90 emihumeni engu-6: izinduku zokuphenya, amabhuloho aphendukayo, iqhwa, amanzi akhuphukayo ne-lava. Thola izinkanyezi ezi-3 ngokunyakaza okumbalwa, futhi umgogodla uyakusiza uma unamathele.
l.card: Phendula izibuko, qondisa imisebe yokukhanya bese ukhanyisa futhi amahholo angu-150 enqaba.
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: phendula izibuko bese uqondisa ukukhanya kumakristalu emazingeni angu-150 nasemhlabeni engu-6 opendiwe.
l.p1: Inqaba icimile. Phendula izibuko namahholo ukuze uqondise imisebe kumakristalu: uma onke ekhanya, umnyango wegolide uyavuleka.
l.p2: Amazinga angu-150 emhlabeni engu-6: imibala yokuxuba, ingilazi enemibala, ama-prism, izithombe ezibaziwe namagiya. Amacebo nezinkanyezi ezi-3 ezingeni ngalinye kwabahlakaniphe kakhulu.
d.card: Gijima, ndiza futhi ukhafule umlilo emibusweni yomlingo engu-7 nakubaphathi bayo abangu-7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: umdlalo wamapulatifomu we-2D opendwe ngesandla. Wela imibuso engu-7, amazinga angu-63 nabaphathi abangu-7 ukuze uxoshe iNkosi Yezithunzi.
d.p1: Dlala njengodrako omncane oluhlaza onesibindi. Gijima, gxuma, ntanta futhi ukhafule umlilo ukuze uxoshe iNkosi Yezithunzi.
d.p2: Imibuso engu-7, amazinga angu-63 nabaphathi abangu-7, ngamunye enobuqili bakhe. Qoqa amakristalu bese uthola izinkanyezi ezifika ku-3 ezingeni ngalinye.
d.f2: Abaphathi abangu-7 okufanele ubanqobe, ngamunye enobuqili bakhe
t.card: Sika, phendula futhi ubeke amafu ukuze uvulele umthungi omncane indlela.
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: amaphazili angu-240 ezifundeni zesibhakabhaka ezingu-12. Sika, phendula futhi ubeke amafu ukuze uvule indlela.
t.p1: Iziqhingi zintanta esibhakabhakeni futhi umnyango womlingo ulindile. Sika amafu, uwaphendule futhi uwabeke ukuze wakhe indlela yomthungi omncane.
t.p2: Amazinga angu-240 ezifundeni ezingu-12 ezipendiwe, ngaphandle kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Thola izinkanyezi ezi-3, vula amabhokisi bese uqoqa amafu.
w.card: Beka amagiya, dlulisa amandla bese uvusa umbuso olele.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: amaphazili omshini angu-150 emhlabeni yezinganekwane engu-6. Beka amagiya bese udlulisa amandla ukuze uqalise kabusha imishini.
w.p1: Isiqalekiso siwuqandisile umbuso. Beka amagiya endaweni efanele ukuze udlulise amandla enjini yomlingo bese wenza imishini isebenze futhi.
w.p2: Amazinga angu-150 emhlabeni engu-6: ama-rune, izinduku zokuphenya, imisebe yekristalu newashi lesihlabathi. Thola izinkanyezi ezi-3 bese ubuka amabalazwe ebuyisa imibala yawo.
u.card: Beka amabhulokhi ama-rune awayo bese uhlanganisa ama-rune ombala ofanayo ukuze anyamalale.
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: beka amabhulokhi ama-rune awayo, hlanganisa imibala futhi uxhume ama-combo emazingeni angu-180 nasezifundeni ezingu-6.
u.p1: Amabhulokhi ama-rune awela ebhodini. Wanyakazise futhi uwaphendule ukuze uhlanganise ama-rune ombala ofanayo: ayanyamalala futhi konke kuwela phansi.
u.p2: Amazinga angu-180 ezifundeni ezingu-6, kusukela eMbhoshongweni Womthakathi kuya eNqabeni Yesibhakabhaka. Xhuma ama-combo ukuze uthole izinkanyezi ezi-3.
n.card: Qondisa udrako, udle ama-rune bese ukhula ngaphandle kokuluma umsila wakho.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: umdlalo wenyoka onodrako. Yidla ama-rune, gwema izithiyo bese unqoba abaqaphi abangu-6 emazingeni angu-120.
n.p1: Udrako akaze ame. Swayipha ukuze umphendule, yidla ama-rune ukuze ukhule futhi ugweme izindonga nomzimba wakho.
n.p2: Amazinga angu-120 ezifundeni ezingu-6, ngasinye siqashwe umphathi. Ama-rune omlingo enza isikhathi sihambe kancane, akwenze isipoki noma akuvikele.
d.f3: Izilawuli zokuthinta ezilula zawo wonke umndeni
